zh-CN.title: 欢迎消息输入栏与聊天完全一致
items: 欢迎消息与聊天会话共用同一套图标、附件展开方式和输入栏排版
语音按钮现在直接录音、试听并发送，不再打开文件选择器

en.title: Welcome messages now match the chat composer
items: Welcome messages now share the same icons, attachment expansion, and composer layout as chat
The voice button now records, previews, and sends audio instead of opening a file picker
